example.name: Expose host services to functions
example.description:
Dagger Functions can also receive host services as function arguments of type `Service`, in the form `tcp://:`. This enables client containers in Dagger Functions to communicate with services running on the host.
:::note This implies that a service is already listening on a port on the host, out-of-band of Dagger. :::
Here is an example of how a container running in a Dagger Function can access and query a MariaDB database service (bound using the alias `db`) running on the host.
